figures.caption: Figure 1: Schematic view of a kernelised functional Bregman divergence. Functions f, g ∈ F are mapped by the kernel mean embedding µ into an RKHS H. When the generator on F factors as Φ = F ◦ µ, the resulting kernelised functional Bregman divergence can be understood directly as a divergence on the kernel mean embeddings, dΦ(f, g) = dF (µ(f), µ(g)). See Proposition 14.

Table 1: Comparison of known properties of our functional Bregman divergences with other types of Bregman divergences. Legend: ✓Known and explicitly shown. ◦ Implicit or likely true (perhaps given the results shown here) but not shown. ? Open question. We remark that concerning metricisation, the proof of Acharyya et al. [2013] nor our proof extend obviously to the FBD on Ls(ν), since they rely heavily on an inner product structure, and suspect that the result does not generalise to this setting. The characterisation of the symmetric divergence result in Theorem 13 relies on a strong hypothesis that the generator is twice differentiable, unlike for the vector BD and pointwise BD results.
